verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no native note templates or saved prompts per meeting type; Fellow's documented output is a standard summary, action items, decisions and topic-based minutes for every meeting. The only route is a build-it-yourself workaround: write or prepend agenda content in Fellow Markdown via the API, or pass transcripts to an external LLM for tailored recaps. Missing for 10: native custom note/summary templates, saved prompts, per-meeting-type format selection (discovery, 1:1, standup), and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
